related_questions.question: What is circulating tumor DNA in cancer diagnosis monitoring and prognosis?
related_questions.snippet: Circulating tumor DNA (ctDNA) has emerged as a dynamic biomarker in cancer, as evidenced by its increasing integration into clinical practice. Carrying tumor specific characteristics, ctDNA can be used to inform treatment selection, monitor response, and identify drug resistance.
